name: syllable
title: Syllable
description: A speech-therapy theme built like a laminated communication board: thick-bordered cells in five code colours, led by solid pink core words — call, book, help.

tokens.--font-sans: all text: one heavy humanist system sans
tokens.--text-l: site name, ledes, core-cell numbers, quotes
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings and cell words
tokens.--color-bg: laminate white (black when dark), inside every cell
tokens.--color-text: black print: text, rules, focus rings
tokens.--color-accent: deep pink: links, core cells, Book outline
tokens.--code-pink: board code 1: cell borders, the mark, top band
tokens.--code-yellow: board code 2: cell borders, top band
tokens.--code-green: board code 3: cell borders, schedule, top band
tokens.--code-blue: board code 4: cell borders, quotes, top band
tokens.--code-orange: board code 5: cell borders, top band
tokens.--cell-height: minimum height of a board cell
tokens.--line-cell: cell border, top band and footer rule thickness
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the board and boxes
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of menu items and buttons
